text: Cenomi Centers' annual report for 2025 lists FAS Real Estate Company Limited as its largest shareholder, with 26.89% of its capital as of 31 December 2025; the company's consolidated financial statements for 2025 (related-party note 14.B.i) state that Saudi FAS Holding Company is the ultimate parent of the company, via its immediate parent company FAS Real Estate Company Limited.
short: FAS Real Estate (26.89%) is Cenomi Centers' largest shareholder; Saudi FAS Holding is the ultimate parent

source.name: Arabian Centres Company (Cenomi Centers): Consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (archived copy of centers.cenomi.com PDF), note 14.B.i (related parties)
source.quote: Saudi FAS Holding Company  is the ultimate parent of the Company via assignment of shares by the Company’s immediate parent company (FAS Real Estate Company Limited)
